description: This file defines the FactoryRuntimeLoader class which implements runtime loading for Twig elements by lazy loading runtime implementations based on a mapping of class names to factory callables.

classes.name: Twig\RuntimeLoader\FactoryRuntimeLoader
classes.description: A class that lazily loads runtime implementations for Twig, using a map of class names to factory callables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the map of class names to factory callables.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and returns the runtime implementation for a given class, or null if not found.
